> “(A) a Federal, State, or local law enforcement agency, including a police department, sheriff’s department, or other law enforcement agency of a State, territory, or political subdivision of a State or territory, or an Indian tribe (as such term is defined in section 4 of the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act (25 U.S.C. 450b)); or

This definition includes a broad range of entities, including federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, as well as agencies or entities authorized to investigate or prosecute criminal violations. It also explicitly includes Indian tribes as defined in the referenced statute.
